blocks.source: Canto VIII
blocks.translation: Canto VIII

blocks.source: Io dico, seguitando, ch’assai prima
blocks.translation: I say, continuing, that long before

blocks.source: che noi fossimo al piè de l’alta torre,
blocks.translation: We to the foot of that high tower had come,

blocks.source: li occhi nostri n’andar suso a la cima
blocks.translation: Our eyes went upward to the summit of it,

blocks.source: per due fiammette che i vedemmo porre,
blocks.translation: By reason of two flamelets we saw placed there,

blocks.source: e un’altra da lungi render cenno,
blocks.translation: And from afar another answer them,

blocks.source: tanto ch’a pena il potea l’occhio tòrre.
blocks.translation: So far, that hardly could the eye attain it.

blocks.source: E io mi volsi al mar di tutto ’l senno;
blocks.translation: And, to the sea of all discernment turned,

blocks.source: dissi: «Questo che dice? e che risponde
blocks.translation: I said: “What sayeth this, and what respondeth

blocks.source: quell’ altro foco? e chi son quei che ’l fenno?».
blocks.translation: That other fire? and who are they that made it?”

blocks.source: Ed elli a me: «Su per le sucide onde
blocks.translation: And he to me: “Across the turbid waves

blocks.source: già scorgere puoi quello che s’aspetta,
blocks.translation: What is expected thou canst now discern,

blocks.source: se ’l fummo del pantan nol ti nasconde».
blocks.translation: If reek of the morass conceal it not.”

blocks.source: Corda non pinse mai da sé saetta
blocks.translation: Cord never shot an arrow from itself

blocks.source: che sì corresse via per l’aere snella,
blocks.translation: That sped away athwart the air so swift,

blocks.source: com’ io vidi una nave piccioletta
blocks.translation: As I beheld a very little boat

blocks.source: venir per l’acqua verso noi in quella,
blocks.translation: Come o’er the water tow’rds us at that moment,

blocks.source: sotto ’l governo d’un sol galeoto,
blocks.translation: Under the guidance of a single pilot,

blocks.source: che gridava: «Or se’ giunta, anima fella!».
blocks.translation: Who shouted, “Now art thou arrived, fell soul?”

blocks.source: «Flegïàs, Flegïàs, tu gridi a vòto»,
blocks.translation: “Phlegyas, Phlegyas, thou criest out in vain

blocks.source: disse lo mio segnore, «a questa volta:
blocks.translation: For this once,” said my Lord; “thou shalt not have us

blocks.source: più non ci avrai che sol passando il loto».
blocks.translation: Longer than in the passing of the slough.”

blocks.source: Qual è colui che grande inganno ascolta
blocks.translation: As he who listens to some great deceit

blocks.source: che li sia fatto, e poi se ne rammarca,
blocks.translation: That has been done to him, and then resents it,

blocks.source: fecesi Flegïàs ne l’ira accolta.
blocks.translation: Such became Phlegyas, in his gathered wrath.

blocks.source: Lo duca mio discese ne la barca,
blocks.translation: My Guide descended down into the boat,

blocks.source: e poi mi fece intrare appresso lui;
blocks.translation: And then he made me enter after him,

blocks.source: e sol quand’ io fui dentro parve carca.
blocks.translation: And only when I entered seemed it laden.

blocks.source: Tosto che ’l duca e io nel legno fui,
blocks.translation: Soon as the Guide and I were in the boat,

blocks.source: segando se ne va l’antica prora
blocks.translation: The antique prow goes on its way, dividing

blocks.source: de l’acqua più che non suol con altrui.
blocks.translation: More of the water than ’tis wont with others.

blocks.source: Mentre noi corravam la morta gora,
blocks.translation: While we were running through the dead canal,

blocks.source: dinanzi mi si fece un pien di fango,
blocks.translation: Uprose in front of me one full of mire,

blocks.source: e disse: «Chi se’ tu che vieni anzi ora?».
blocks.translation: And said, “Who ’rt thou that comest ere the hour?”

blocks.source: E io a lui: «S’i’ vegno, non rimango;
blocks.translation: And I to him: “Although I come, I stay not;

blocks.source: ma tu chi se’, che sì se’ fatto brutto?».
blocks.translation: But who art thou that hast become so squalid?”

blocks.source: Rispuose: «Vedi che son un che piango».
blocks.translation: “Thou seest that I am one who weeps,” he answered.

blocks.source: E io a lui: «Con piangere e con lutto,
blocks.translation: And I to him: “With weeping and with wailing,

blocks.source: spirito maladetto, ti rimani;
blocks.translation: Thou spirit maledict, do thou remain;

blocks.source: ch’i’ ti conosco, ancor sie lordo tutto».
blocks.translation: For thee I know, though thou art all defiled.”

blocks.source: Allor distese al legno ambo le mani;
blocks.translation: Then stretched he both his hands unto the boat;

blocks.source: per che ’l maestro accorto lo sospinse,
blocks.translation: Whereat my wary Master thrust him back,

blocks.source: dicendo: «Via costà con li altri cani!».
blocks.translation: Saying, “Away there with the other dogs!”

blocks.source: Lo collo poi con le braccia mi cinse;
blocks.translation: Thereafter with his arms he clasped my neck;

blocks.source: basciommi ’l volto e disse: «Alma sdegnosa,
blocks.translation: He kissed my face, and said: “Disdainful soul,

blocks.source: benedetta colei che ’n te s’incinse!
blocks.translation: Blessed be she who bore thee in her bosom.

blocks.source: Quei fu al mondo persona orgogliosa;
blocks.translation: That was an arrogant person in the world;

blocks.source: bontà non è che sua memoria fregi:
blocks.translation: Goodness is none, that decks his memory;

blocks.source: così s’è l’ombra sua qui furïosa.
blocks.translation: So likewise here his shade is furious.

blocks.source: Quanti si tegnon or là sù gran regi
blocks.translation: How many hold themselves great kings up there,

blocks.source: che qui staranno come porci in brago,
blocks.translation: Who here shall be like unto swine in mire,

blocks.source: di sé lasciando orribili dispregi!».
blocks.translation: Leaving behind them horrible dispraises!”

blocks.source: E io: «Maestro, molto sarei vago
blocks.translation: And I: “My Master, much should I be pleased,

blocks.source: di vederlo attuffare in questa broda
blocks.translation: If I could see him soused into this broth,

blocks.source: prima che noi uscissimo del lago».
blocks.translation: Before we issue forth out of the lake.”

blocks.source: Ed elli a me: «Avante che la proda
blocks.translation: And he to me: “Ere unto thee the shore

blocks.source: ti si lasci veder, tu sarai sazio:
blocks.translation: Reveal itself, thou shalt be satisfied;

blocks.source: di tal disïo convien che tu goda».
blocks.translation: Such a desire ’tis meet thou shouldst enjoy.”

blocks.source: Dopo ciò poco vid’ io quello strazio
blocks.translation: A little after that, I saw such havoc

blocks.source: far di costui a le fangose genti,
blocks.translation: Made of him by the people of the mire,

blocks.source: che Dio ancor ne lodo e ne ringrazio.
blocks.translation: That still I praise and thank my God for it.

blocks.source: Tutti gridavano: «A Filippo Argenti!»;
blocks.translation: They all were shouting, “At Philippo Argenti!”

blocks.source: e ’l fiorentino spirito bizzarro
blocks.translation: And that exasperate spirit Florentine

blocks.source: in sé medesmo si volvea co’ denti.
blocks.translation: Turned round upon himself with his own teeth.

blocks.source: Quivi il lasciammo, che più non ne narro;
blocks.translation: We left him there, and more of him I tell not;

blocks.source: ma ne l’orecchie mi percosse un duolo,
blocks.translation: But on mine ears there smote a lamentation,

blocks.source: per ch’io avante l’occhio intento sbarro.
blocks.translation: Whence forward I intent unbar mine eyes.

blocks.source: Lo buon maestro disse: «Omai, figliuolo,
blocks.translation: And the good Master said: “Even now, my Son,

blocks.source: s’appressa la città c’ha nome Dite,
blocks.translation: The city draweth near whose name is Dis,

blocks.source: coi gravi cittadin, col grande stuolo».
blocks.translation: With the grave citizens, with the great throng.”

blocks.source: E io: «Maestro, già le sue meschite
blocks.translation: And I: “Its mosques already, Master, clearly

blocks.source: là entro certe ne la valle cerno,
blocks.translation: Within there in the valley I discern

blocks.source: vermiglie come se di foco uscite
blocks.translation: Vermilion, as if issuing from the fire

blocks.source: fossero». Ed ei mi disse: «Il foco etterno
blocks.translation: They were.”  And he to me: “The fire eternal

blocks.source: ch’entro l’affoca le dimostra rosse,
blocks.translation: That kindles them within makes them look red,

blocks.source: come tu vedi in questo basso inferno».
blocks.translation: As thou beholdest in this nether Hell.”

blocks.source: Noi pur giugnemmo dentro a l’alte fosse
blocks.translation: Then we arrived within the moats profound,

blocks.source: che vallan quella terra sconsolata:
blocks.translation: That circumvallate that disconsolate city;

blocks.source: le mura mi parean che ferro fosse.
blocks.translation: The walls appeared to me to be of iron.

blocks.source: Non sanza prima far grande aggirata,
blocks.translation: Not without making first a circuit wide,

blocks.source: venimmo in parte dove il nocchier forte
blocks.translation: We came unto a place where loud the pilot

blocks.source: «Usciteci», gridò: «qui è l’intrata».
blocks.translation: Cried out to us, “Debark, here is the entrance.”

blocks.source: Io vidi più di mille in su le porte
blocks.translation: More than a thousand at the gates I saw

blocks.source: da ciel piovuti, che stizzosamente
blocks.translation: Out of the Heavens rained down, who angrily

blocks.source: dicean: «Chi è costui che sanza morte
blocks.translation: Were saying, “Who is this that without death

blocks.source: va per lo regno de la morta gente?».
blocks.translation: Goes through the kingdom of the people dead?”

blocks.source: E ’l savio mio maestro fece segno
blocks.translation: And my sagacious Master made a sign

blocks.source: di voler lor parlar segretamente.
blocks.translation: Of wishing secretly to speak with them.

blocks.source: Allor chiusero un poco il gran disdegno
blocks.translation: A little then they quelled their great disdain,

blocks.source: e disser: «Vien tu solo, e quei sen vada
blocks.translation: And said: “Come thou alone, and he begone

blocks.source: che sì ardito intrò per questo regno.
blocks.translation: Who has so boldly entered these dominions.

blocks.source: Sol si ritorni per la folle strada:
blocks.translation: Let him return alone by his mad road;

blocks.source: pruovi, se sa; ché tu qui rimarrai,
blocks.translation: Try, if he can; for thou shalt here remain,

blocks.source: che li ha’ iscorta sì buia contrada».
blocks.translation: Who hast escorted him through such dark regions.”

blocks.source: Pensa, lettor, se io mi sconfortai
blocks.translation: Think, Reader, if I was discomforted

blocks.source: nel suon de le parole maladette,
blocks.translation: At utterance of the accursed words;

blocks.source: ché non credetti ritornarci mai.
blocks.translation: For I believed I never should return.

blocks.source: «O caro duca mio, che più di sette
blocks.translation: “O my dear Guide, who more than seven times

blocks.source: volte m’hai sicurtà renduta e tratto
blocks.translation: Hast rendered me security, and drawn me

blocks.source: d’alto periglio che ’ncontra mi stette,
blocks.translation: From imminent peril that before me stood,

blocks.source: non mi lasciar», diss’ io, «così disfatto;
blocks.translation: Do not desert me,” said I, “thus undone;

blocks.source: e se ’l passar più oltre ci è negato,
blocks.translation: And if the going farther be denied us,

blocks.source: ritroviam l’orme nostre insieme ratto».
blocks.translation: Let us retrace our steps together swiftly.”

blocks.source: E quel segnor che lì m’avea menato,
blocks.translation: And that Lord, who had led me thitherward,

blocks.source: mi disse: «Non temer; ché ’l nostro passo
blocks.translation: Said unto me: “Fear not; because our passage

blocks.source: non ci può tòrre alcun: da tal n’è dato.
blocks.translation: None can take from us, it by Such is given.

blocks.source: Ma qui m’attendi, e lo spirito lasso
blocks.translation: But here await me, and thy weary spirit

blocks.source: conforta e ciba di speranza buona,
blocks.translation: Comfort and nourish with a better hope;

blocks.source: ch’i’ non ti lascerò nel mondo basso».
blocks.translation: For in this nether world I will not leave thee.”

blocks.source: Così sen va, e quivi m’abbandona
blocks.translation: So onward goes and there abandons me

blocks.source: lo dolce padre, e io rimagno in forse,
blocks.translation: My Father sweet, and I remain in doubt,

blocks.source: che sì e no nel capo mi tenciona.
blocks.translation: For No and Yes within my head contend.

blocks.source: Udir non potti quello ch’a lor porse;
blocks.translation: I could not hear what he proposed to them;

blocks.source: ma ei non stette là con essi guari,
blocks.translation: But with them there he did not linger long,

blocks.source: che ciascun dentro a pruova si ricorse.
blocks.translation: Ere each within in rivalry ran back.

blocks.source: Chiuser le porte que’ nostri avversari
blocks.translation: They closed the portals, those our adversaries,

blocks.source: nel petto al mio segnor, che fuor rimase
blocks.translation: On my Lord’s breast, who had remained without

blocks.source: e rivolsesi a me con passi rari.
blocks.translation: And turned to me with footsteps far between.

blocks.source: Li occhi a la terra e le ciglia avea rase
blocks.translation: His eyes cast down, his forehead shorn had he

blocks.source: d’ogne baldanza, e dicea ne’ sospiri:
blocks.translation: Of all its boldness, and he said, with sighs,

blocks.source: «Chi m’ha negate le dolenti case!».
blocks.translation: “Who has denied to me the dolesome houses?”

blocks.source: E a me disse: «Tu, perch’ io m’adiri,
blocks.translation: And unto me: “Thou, because I am angry,

blocks.source: non sbigottir, ch’io vincerò la prova,
blocks.translation: Fear not, for I will conquer in the trial,

blocks.source: qual ch’a la difension dentro s’aggiri.
blocks.translation: Whatever for defence within be planned.

blocks.source: Questa lor tracotanza non è nova;
blocks.translation: This arrogance of theirs is nothing new;

blocks.source: ché già l’usaro a men segreta porta,
blocks.translation: For once they used it at less secret gate,

blocks.source: la qual sanza serrame ancor si trova.
blocks.translation: Which finds itself without a fastening still.

blocks.source: Sovr’ essa vedestù la scritta morta:
blocks.translation: O’er it didst thou behold the dead inscription;

blocks.source: e già di qua da lei discende l’erta,
blocks.translation: And now this side of it descends the steep,

blocks.source: passando per li cerchi sanza scorta,
blocks.translation: Passing across the circles without escort,

blocks.source: tal che per lui ne fia la terra aperta».
blocks.translation: One by whose means the city shall be opened.”
